purpose: Restore bounded incremental analysis behavior from the mature pre-Rust planner without changing canonical results.

restored_behavior.dependency_scope: one-hop reverse dependency emission with one-hop forward context
restored_behavior.python_additions: incremental unless a new module can satisfy an addition-sensitive unresolved reference
restored_behavior.python_renames: same-language rename represented as removed old path plus added new path
restored_behavior.python_context: changed files plus imported modules and package initializers
restored_behavior.pyproject_filtering: tool-only changes do not schedule Python analysis; project/dependency changes remain structural
restored_behavior.topology_validation: resolved topology changes validated after scoped analysis rather than forcing full analysis up front
restored_behavior.shared_materialization: keyed merge of scoped shared updates with prior shared facts, invalidating facts attributable to changed/removed files

unresolved_import_satisfied_by_addition.example: from pkg.missing import x, then add pkg/missing.py

note: Fixture timings used the repo-built debug lifecycle profiler and are diagnostic only; Phase 7 acceptance is semantic equivalence and bounded planner behavior.
